info.title: ExeMem Cloud API
info.description: Design-only OpenAPI for the action-based cloud interface. Three product actions: POST /api/cloud/v3/{fetch,push,manage} with intent tagged unions. Live home after implementation: cloud_backup_protocol/cloud-api.openapi.json. Protocol version 3 via X-LastDB-Cloud-Protocol. No cloud storage resource names in routes or request fields.

post.description: Tagged union on intent. Node nouns only; cloud chooses storage.
create_database may require apiKey. Grants are signed entries; no list/revision.
Owner maintenance. Off the public fetch/push/manage product surface.
Tagged union on intent. file/backup use opaque tickets. Dual-auth when account key required.

CloudProtocol.name: X-LastDB-Cloud-Protocol
CloudProtocol.description: Required on storage actions. Not used on auth-service.

accountBearer.description: Enrollment key for auth-service key/payment routes.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: em_… account key. Used with LastDBNode where dual-auth applies.

lastDbNode.description: Authorization: LastDBNode <token>. Path-bound to the action URL.

githubOidc.description: GitHub Actions OIDC for DEV snapshot-proof.

cursor.description: Opaque cloud-issued cursor. Empty/absent = from start per cloud rules.

file_handle.description: Opaque cloud-issued file handle. Not a storage key.

self_access.description: Own grant view. Not a MemberList revision.

ticket.description: Opaque upload ticket from a prior push/file response. Absent = begin.

stage.description: Ticket stage. begin issues ticket; complete finishes.

upload_url.description: Opaque short-lived upload URL. Treat as opaque; see open question R1.

proof_id.description: Opaque DEV proof id. No bucket fields.
